description: A low bar with its door recessed deep enough to keep the rain off two smokers and nobody else. The sign is a pigeon in flaking paint. Under it hangs a newer board where the daily has been written and half-wiped so many times the surface has gone furry. The extractor breathes old fryer oil out at ankle height across the pavement. The door is south; Voss Avenue runs north.
name: The Dead Pigeon
